sections.Profile:
"Brite Star" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1958. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, and three roto-targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
